title: Todo planning structure and validator
purpose: Establish the mandatory Todo planning structure, canonical schema, template, lifecycle directories, automated validator and CI gate required by AGENTS.md sections 1-8 and 26.
architecturalScope: Repository tooling. Not part of the runtime product; enables all other tracks to be planned, tracked and validated.
domainContext: Todo track, milestone, task, risk, verification requirement. Status is bound to lifecycle directory.

milestones.title: Structure and schema
milestones.description: Lifecycle directories, canonical schema and template exist.

milestones.title: Automated validation
milestones.description: Validator enforces all AGENTS.md section 26 checks and runs in CI.

acceptanceCriteria: All tracks validate against the canonical schema.
Directory and status are consistent for every track.
The validator exits non-zero on any violation.

risks.description: Schema diverges from practice and gets bypassed.
risks.mitigation: CI gate required for merge; template kept minimal.

safetyImplications: None directly; planning integrity supports safety process traceability.
accessibilityImplications: Planning documentation must remain textual and screen-reader friendly.
privacyImplications: No personal data in planning artifacts.
verificationRequirements: python3 tools/validate_todos.py exits 0 on the repository.

decisionLog.decision: Use JSON Schema draft 2020-12 and a stdlib+jsonschema validator, run in GitHub Actions.
decisionLog.rationale: Declarative schema, easy CI integration, minimal dependencies.
